name: rtx3070
description: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 (GA104, Ampere, sm_86) at its 1500 MHz base clock: one Vortex core per SM; the SM is GA106's (rtx3060).

sources.SM (all core knobs): Inherited from rtx3060: GA104 uses the same GA10x SM as GA106 (128 FP32 cores, 4 tensor cores, 100 KB shared memory, 128 KB L1/shared)
sources.NUM_CORES: 46 SMs, 5888 CUDA cores (NVIDIA Ampere GA102 whitepaper, Appendix A, RTX 3070 column)
sources.L2_SIZE, L2_NUM_WAYS, L2_NUM_BANKS: 4 MB L2 (GA104): 16 ways over power-of-two sets; one bank per memory channel
sources.PLATFORM_MEMORY_TYPE, PLATFORM_MEMORY_NU: 256-bit GDDR6 at 14 Gbps: 8 devices x 2 x16 channels = 16 channels at 14000 MT/s: 16 x 2 B x 14 GT/s = 448 GB/s (whitepaper)
sources.PLATFORM_CLOCK_RATE: 1500 MHz base clock (1725 MHz boost), base as in rtx3060
sources.reference: fp32_lanes is the vendor FP32 core count (FP32 FMA lanes per chip, clock-free); dram_bandwidth_gbs the vendor peak. Checked by ci/profile_check.py. Accel-Sim (accel-sim-framework) correlates this card: GPGPU-Sim tested-cfg SM86_RTX3070 and posted hardware runs (ampere-rtx3070)
